description: Software ledger for the barebone EDGAR arm on SEC submissions metadata and the locked Yahoo tape. The score is log1p of the 8-K, 10-Q, and 10-K count in the 63 sessions ending at the decision session, minus the cross-sectional median. Availability is acceptanceDateTime. Amendments are excluded. The book is sized only when expanding Spearman skill versus the next-session residual is strictly above zero; otherwise it is cash. Position and gross caps stay 0.10 and 1.0. This is not a performance claim.
